jobs.title: Consultant Town Planner
jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grown Here.

We have an opportunity for a Consultant Town Planner.
AECOM’s Planning and Stakeholder Engagement business is recruiting Consultant Planners to help deliver our existing portfolio of projects and a pipeline of projects, across a range of sectors, principally delivering large scale infrastructure.

As our Town Planning team is national, and we support hybrid working we are flexible in terms of base location. The role can be based from our offices in Basingstoke, and London Aldgate
with an option for hybrid working.

Here’s what you’ll do:

You will be joining a market leading, experienced infrastructure planning team and will, be given the following responsibilities.

Planning & Development Management

Assist in the management and successful delivery of major development applications.
Provide planning advice to colleagues and clients, including the application of permitted development rights.
Carry out planning research and analysis and assist with the identification of planning risks.

Technical Reporting & Documentation

Prepare Planning Statements and Design and Access Statements to support development applications.
Liaise with the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) team to ensure coordinated project delivery.

Project Coordination & Delivery

Help coordinate multi-disciplinary teams across a variety of project types.
Assist with project management activities to support successful project outcomes.
Implement quality assurance and health and safety principles.

Business Development & Commercial Support

Contribute to the preparation of successful commercial tenders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Participate in internal and external meetings.
Build effective working relationships with colleagues, clients, and project stakeholders.

Does this sound like something you can do, and do well? If so, read on…

MORE ABOUT THE WORK
- We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it’s improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

We have an impressive portfolio of involvement in major infrastructure projects, including delivery of projects through various consenting regimes including Development Consent Orders. We are currently leading on consenting applications for renewables and wider energy/electricity related infrastructure, transport, defence, water and much more.

You will be able to work on a range of prestigious infrastructure projects for our clients in the energy transition, rail and water development sectors, as well as regional and local developments. AECOM is a market leader in UK infrastructure development, with experience of over 80 Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects. Join us now and you could be working on:
numerous solar DCOs with a pipeline of future work;
carbon capture and energy storage projects;
energy transmission schemes including for National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade;
large aviation and rail projects; and
housing and mixed-use development consenting.

PLANNING AT AECOM
- AECOM is a top ten UK Planning consultancy by size, employing around 70 Chartered or Licentiate Planners, practicing in all areas of the discipline. AECOM is also a worldwide leader in environmental and engineering consultancy and working as a planning consultant within AECOM means access to some of the highest profile and prestigious development projects in the UK, working with colleagues operating at the cutting edge of their disciplines as part of the largest UK environmental consultancy.

You will be joining a great team; you will have an interesting and diverse workload and you will be given the opportunity to make the most of your abilities.

What's not to like? Come and join us and we'll grow together.

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Professional Qualifications

Licentiate Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional town planning organisation and working towards full accreditation.

Planning & Technical Expertise

Demonstrable experience of working on major planning applications.
Sound knowledge of UK planning policy and legislation.
Experience of working on Development Consent Order (DCO) and/or Transport and Works Act Order (TWAO) applications.
Understanding of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) legislation.
Experience identifying, evaluating, and managing planning risk.

Commercial & Consultancy Skills

Commercial awareness and the ability to write clearly and concisely.
Consultancy experience, including monitoring and managing project budgets and programmes.

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

Client-focused with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach, demonstrating a high level of commitment to quality.
Experience working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

Project Delivery & Technical Competencies

Ability to work effectively to tight deadlines.
Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

Additional Information

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

For further information about the role, reach out to the recruiter on LinkedIn Anne Marie Flynn | LinkedIn

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

📍Manchester (Hybrid, up to 2 days WFH) 💰 £30k-£36k, dependent on experience (OTE up to £42k)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

If you join us, you’ll be helping to improve the property industry for everyone. As a Customer Success Manager you’ll be ensuring our customers are getting the most out of our award-winning prospecting tool, Spectre
. You’re a real self-starter, a great communicator, and a confident and talented problem-solver, who isn’t afraid of going above and beyond for our customers.

This is a fast-paced role where no two days are ever the same - on any given day, you could be running a strategy call, working a retention, spotting an upsell opportunity, or providing best practice guidance. You'll also work closely with other teams across the business, giving feedback on product development and technical issues, and supporting launches of new product features.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

A bit about you…

You have a background in Customer Success or Retentions, with real experience retaining customers and handling objections
You're a motivated self-starter who works well independently and is excited by the opportunity to help scale a business during a high-growth phase
You're highly organised with exceptional attention to detail
You are passionate about providing an exceptional customer experience and building lasting relationships
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluency in written and spoken English)
You're tech-savvy and genuinely open to picking up new tools and systems quickly, from our CRM to AI-assisted workflows - we care more about your curiosity and adaptability than which specific tools you've used before

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L2 Customer Success Manager at Street Group

Supporting our clients to achieve great results with Spectre; from proactively ensuring existing clients are getting the most out of the system through strategy calls, quarterly business reviews, and training sessions
Proactively identifying accounts at risk and working retention conversations and objection handling to keep customers on board
Implementing creative solutions to proactively resolve potential issues for customers before they escalate
Identifying and acting on upsell and cross-sell opportunities with existing clients
Visiting clients face-to-face to build genuine relationships and get a first-hand view of their business
Providing exceptional technical support via phone and email to Spectre clients
Ensuring feedback flows from Customer Success to the relevant business and product teams

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre
is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home 2 days per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿 💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

£30,000 - £36,000 dependent on experience (OTE up to £42,000). However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

Interview Process

3 stages = Introductory call with one of our Talent team > In-person interview with our Head of CS and Senior CSM > Final interview with our Head of Operations and Senior CSM.
We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

With Every Community, Stantec Redefines What’s Possible.

Application Deadline: Recruitment is ongoing. Please apply as soon as possible as the advert may close once we have sufficient applicants.

The Opportunity

Join our 2027 Graduate Programme as a Graduate Urban Designer
in our Bristol
office, where you'll be part of a market-leading Community Development discipline.

As a Graduate Urban Designer, you'll join a team of 20 urban design professionals based primarily in Bristol, working on a diverse range of projects that help shape sustainable, high-quality places. Supported by experienced Senior Urban Designers, Associates and Directors, you'll develop your technical and creative skills while gaining hands-on project experience. You'll also collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of Architects, Landscape Architects and Planners, giving you exposure to different perspectives and the opportunity to contribute to innovative design solutions from day one.

You'll have the opportunity to contribute to a diverse portfolio of residential and mixed-use developments, including urban extensions, new settlements and regeneration projects. Assist with the preparation of masterplans, vision documents and other design-led project outputs.
Contribute to the production of Design and Access Statements and related planning documentation.
Work collaboratively with colleagues to develop design codes and place-based design guidance.
Support Senior and Associate Urban Designers in the delivery of projects, gaining hands-on experience across a variety of project stages and scales.

We are committed to supporting employees in achieving relevant professional qualifications and accreditation.

This role will help deliver sustainable, resilient infrastructure and community developments that create lasting benefits for people, places and the environment. At Stantec, we value your potential over past experience. Along with your Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Urban Design, a knowledge of AutoCAD, Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Indesign), Sketchup, Microsoft Office would be desirable, we’d love to receive your application if you are:-

An Adapter - You’re able to remain calm in new and changing situations, comfortably switching between a variety of dynamic and exciting tasks.
A Perseverer - You stay composed in the face of setbacks, approaching challenges with confidence and determination.
An Eager Learner - You learn from your experiences and the world around you, using this knowledge to anticipate how situations may unfold.
A Collaborator - You work effectively with lots of different people, considering others’ perspectives to shape better outcomes.
A Problem-Solver - You love to give your thoughts based on what you see, being unafraid to challenge conventional thinking.

Please note, we ask our graduates to come into the office 4 days per week, to ensure that you receive sufficient time with your team and receive the appropriate level of support.

Applicants must have an unconditional right to live and work in the UK for an indefinite period without limitation.

Why Join Us?

What We Can Offer You

A competitive salary
Private medical insurance
A range of benefits, including holiday buy and sell, group income protection and life assurance
Permanent employment contract to demonstrate our commitment to your long-term career at Stantec
Professional progression plan, supporting you to gain professional chartership
A supportive and collaborative team environment and Early Careers peer group and wider ERG network (see more on our ERGs here: Stantec Employee Resource Groups )

Graduate Application FAQs

jobs.description:
At Buro Happold, we are redefining what great cities look like—creating places that are sustainable, inclusive, and resilient. We are now seeking an Strategic Planning Consultant to join our Global Urban Strategies team, playing a key leadership role in shaping city-scale solutions across the UK and internationally.

The role will be based from our London office with hybrid working.

We are looking for a person passionate about solving the challenges facing cities who has specialist urban and strategic planning skills to join our London based team.

You will have an opportunity to play a role in shaping and delivering projects combining our data analytics and urban modelling with our core strategic advisory, planning, economics, infrastructure and environment capabilities.

You should have 2+ years post qualification experience. We are looking for a talented urban planner who is a team player and strong project collaborator.

Required Skills

Demonstrate an understanding of urban development challenges and the value of providing integrated urban development and strategic planning solutions.
Excellent problem solver able to interpret and understand the implications of analytical outputs
Awareness and understanding of what it takes to deliver effective and viable client outcomes in a commercial working environment.
Ability to liaise with internal and external clients to promote urban and regional development solutions and deliver high quality input into their projects.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable working with quantitative datasets and building clear data-driven narratives
Demonstrate an ability to prepare high-quality reports of a technical nature.

Specialist technical
and sector expertise
in one or more of the following areas:

Strategic advisory for urban plans, programmes and projects
Preparation of regional and city scale planning frameworks
Development planning and masterplanning of large-scale mixed-use developments
Data analytics and geo-spatial analysis
Understanding of how statutory plan-making systems work: policy hierarchies, evidence requirements and approval processes and the ability to transfer that thinking into unfamiliar national and regional planning contexts.
An awareness of the factors that determine whether plans and projects are deliverable, land ownership and assembly, phasing, infrastructure funding, and governance and delivery arrangements and a willingness to develop this understanding.
Preparation of projects and programmes to support urban development including infrastructure planning and business case for economic, social and green infrastructure programmes and projects.
Demonstrate strong cultural and institutional awareness, recognising how governance structures, land tenure and delivery mechanisms differ between geographies and shape what is deliverable.
Competent in GIS (QGIS or ArcGIS) for spatial analysis and the production of publication-quality mapping;

Desirable Skills

Familiarity with the UK plan-making system, including the NPPF, Local Plans and the emerging spatial development strategy regime for strategic authorities.
Involvement in delivering integrated urban development, strategic spatial planning projects.
Experience in urban resilience, climate change mitigation and adaptation, strategic environmental management and sustainable development strategies
Involvement in delivering regional planning, masterplanning and urban design projects
Working familiarity with CAD (2D and 3D) — in particular georeferencing and converting CAD masterplan, survey and land-parcel drawings for use in GIS
Experience using Adobe Illustrator and InDesign, or similar graphics software
Foreign language skills
Experience of planning practice in more than one country, or of adapting methodologies developed in one regulatory context for use in another
Willingness to travel for client meetings and workshops.

Qualifications

Essential - Degree in a field allied to strategic urban planning such as geography, town planning, social science, geographic information science, environmental science, or architecture.
Desirable - Masters degree in urban planning, spatial planning, urban design, or similar
Desirable – RTPI chartered or with a clear route to Licentiate/Chartered membership; equivalent international body considered.

Role & Responsibilities

Developing tailored consulting technical solutions; delivering an approach that adapts to our clients understanding, experience and needs.
Undertaking pieces of planning and urban development research to feed into projects.
Preparation of technical reports and client presentations.
Engaging with Buro Happold colleagues from other technical disciplines and / or external collaborators to provide integrated reports and solutions for our clients.
Coordinating inputs from other disciplines into integrated deliverables and maintaining the quality, traceability and internal consistency of project outputs, including comment tracking and client response
Contributing towards innovation, technical capability and skills development initiatives and programmes.
Support senior members of the team in preparation of proposals, fee estimates and bid material
You may be required to work on projects either the UK or overseas as the need requires.
The post holder must at all times carry out their duties with due regard to the BuroHappold Equality & Diversity Policy.
You are required to set a personal example in all aspects of Occupational Health and Safety (OH&S).
You are responsible for encouraging and maintaining high standards of OH&S in all areas under your control; meeting or exceeding targets and reporting on OH&S Key Performance Indicators. You will ensure compliance with the Company’s health and safety policy, relevant legislation and guidance in these areas.
You are required to fulfil the duties appropriate to your grade as detailed in the Roles & Responsibilities section of the Company’s Health & Safety Management System

Apply today and be where exceptional is everywhere.

A place for everyone

Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.

Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

The Opportunity

Our award-winning Town Planning team are seeking to recruit a Senior/Principal Planning Consultant to join our Birmingham office to support the leadership and growth of the team. This is a great opportunity to work with Arup planning leadership nationally to develop and grow the Birmingham planning team. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and challenging projects using your leadership, consulting and technical skills.

We would welcome applications from candidates with development management experience to deliver our diverse portfolio of work. What is key to the role is an understanding of the planning context in Birmingham and the West Midlands, with strong work winning skills to maximise our presence in the area.

You will have the opportunity to work across a portfolio of development management projects including commercial, residential, regeneration and infrastructure. You will work closely with the Planning Lead for the Mid-West region which includes the Bristol, Cardiff, Nottingham and Birmingham offices, as well as working closely with various sector leads within the Arup planning team. You will also provide leadership to multidisciplinary planning and design teams.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

Is this role right for you?

The role will have a focus on leading and developing the development management service offer in Birmingham, developing client relationships and identifying project opportunities such as bidding and delivering projects to support raising Arup's profile and promoting our work in the marketplace. You will play a key role in growing our market profile in Birmingham and West Midlands by engaging with existing and potential clients, positioning Arup to ensure there is a strong pipeline and identifying opportunities for new work.

Skills

The role will also involve leading the delivery of projects in terms of client interface, providing strategic direction to the team, ensuring QA and ensuring projects are profitable. This will include interfacing with multi-disciplinary project teams across Arup to ensure client/project opportunities are maximised and integrated delivery of projects. You will have the following skills and attributes:

Education to degree and/or masters in Town Planning and a Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (MRTPI).
Experience of working in Birmingham in a development management with a good understanding of the market.
Experience of working within a commercial environment (bids and projects), including client liaison, programme and time management, quality assurance and financial/budget control.
In-depth knowledge and application of planning legislation and policy, including ongoing reforms.
Proven consultancy skills, working with clients to understand their requirements and business development.
A background in managing teams in the bidding and delivery of projects and sourcing sub-consultants where necessary.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

AECOM’s Urbanism + Planning practice is a continuum of design vision and strategic advisory that transforms communities. We lead through integration, shaping the social infrastructure that connects us all. U+P’s primary focus includes urban planning, urban design, landscape architecture, workplace strategy, business transformation, asset advisory, economics, and environmental planning.

With a range of expertise from strategy and design through project realization, we create better outcomes to grow economies, protect natural systems, conserve natural resources, make societies more equitable, and connect and engage people through innovative, sustainable design solutions.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Senior Urban Planning Project Managerto support our growing Buildings & Places Business Line. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. AECOM’s Urbanism + Planning team is seeking a creative and experienced urban planner or urban designer to join its practice to manage and contribute to complex projects.

The role will lead transformative, large-scale urban design and master planning projects across the East Coast, with a focus on TOD, mixed-use development, placemaking, downtown revitalization, and public realm design in the Washington, DC region. Working collaboratively with urban designers, planners, landscape architects, engineers, and economists, the urban planner or urban designer will provide planning and urban design leadership, project management, client engagement, and business development for municipal, state, and private-sector clients.

Our teams have worked on transformative planning and urban design projects for high profile clients through the United States, including for major transit, transportation, economic development, and planning agencies.

The job responsibilities for the position will include but are not limited to:

Project Management & Leadership:
In partnership with various Urbanism + Planning studios, lead complex, multidisciplinary projects from concept through implementation, including master plans, economic development strategies, land use and built form studies, public realm strategies, placemaking initiatives, and urban design guidelines.
Manage project scope, schedule, budget, work plans, and deliverables across multiple concurrent projects, project phases, and multidisciplinary teams.
Establish and maintain planning and urban design direction, quality, and consistency throughout project delivery while balancing innovation, feasibility, budget, and schedule.

Technical Support & Plan Production:
Prepare conditions assessments, land use and real estate analysis, diagrams and renderings, and high-quality presentations and reports that effectively communicate planning concepts, economic development considerations, and urban design vision for complex projects.
Lead and coordinate interdisciplinary teams, integrating civil, structural, transportation, environmental, landscape, and other technical disciplines into cohesive and viable planning and urban design solutions.
Translate complex planning and urban design concepts into clear, compelling diagrams, visualizations, reports, and presentations for a range of audiences.
Lead stakeholder engagement strategies and creative outreach efforts, including brand development, professional templates and style guides, event planning, meeting facilitation, online forums, and digital tools.

Client Relationships & Business Development:
Lead and support client presentations, workshops, stakeholder meetings, and public engagement sessions with confidence, enthusiasm, and clarity.
Lead and support proposal development, scopes of work, fee and budget development, work plans, and project interviews.
Support client relationship-building efforts, identifying opportunities to expand existing relationships and develop new business.
Represent AECOM by presenting at industry conferences and through participation in organizations.

Qualifications

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
BA/BS in Planning, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture or related field + 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
Demonstrated project management experience on complex, multidisciplinary, large-scale planning, urban design, and economic development projects, especially in urban and mixed-use contexts

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Masters Degree in Planning, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture or related field
Business development experience, including supporting and leading urban design and planning proposals for public sector and private sector clients
Significant experience producing high-quality written narrative and graphics for reports and presentations, with the ability to present ideas effectively to internal and external audiences
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign).
Advanced proficiency directing and reviewing urban design production, including 2D and 3D site plans, building massing studies, diagrams, and renderings
Proficiency in GIS and map-based data analytics
Positive, proactive approach to teamwork and problem-solving
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
Excellent time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
AICP certification or active pursuit of certification preferred

Additional Information

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
Relocation is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $125000 to $165000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
ICON is looking for a customer service oriented, and operationally driven Senior Customer Success Manager to join our growing Titan Customer Success team. As the first company to commercially scale 3D construction printing, we deploy a complex, multi-stage customer journey from purchasing a printer to planning and executing successful 3D printing construction projects.
We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own relationships with our Titan customers end-to-end - from onboarding through active project support. You'll serve as their primary point of contact for assigned customers and ensure they have what they need to succeed at every stage of a complex, multi-phase journey. You'll also help build the processes and tools that scale the CS function as the team grows.
This role is based at ICON's Austin, TX campus and reports directly to the Director of Customer Success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Ownership
Coordinate closely with the team to ensure every customer interaction, question, and request is handled promptly, professionally, and to the highest standard of customer experience.
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers — owning introductions, ongoing communications, and meeting cadences from onboarding through active project execution.
Own the customer onboarding process end-to-end, ensuring agreements, intake materials, and information packages are completed accurately and on time.
Proactively identify and resolve risks across the customer journey (e.g., contractual obligations, training, material orders, site validations) to keep projects on schedule.

Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate closely within the Customer Success team to organize and coordinate internal cross functional handoffs across Sales, Training, Design, Material Operations, Site Support, and Engineering Services for smooth transitions at each customer journey milestone, and onboard new customers into ICON's internal systems.
Ensure ICON’s centralized customer tracking system, HubSpot, accurately reflects each account’s journey stage and key commitments, giving leadership a reliable view of account health.
Serve as the internal point of contact for tracking customer status, surfacing blockers and gaps, and escalating to the Director of Customer Success with clear context and recommended next steps.
Gather status updates from cross-functional teams to keep customer-facing commitments accurately reflected internally.

Scaling the Team
Leverage AI tools to keep customer data organized at scale, surface patterns, and automate routine tracking. Build internal dashboards, trackers, and reporting templates the broader CS and operations teams adopt.
Build and maintain a library of of customer-facing tools and assets (cost calculators, presentations, forms, timeline visuals, intake questionnaires) that scales the Customer Success journey end-to-end.
Establish internal documentation, SOPs, and templates that standardize how customer information is captured, organized, and communicated across the Customer Success team.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, Architecture or a related field.
8+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, account coordination, project coordination, or operations support.
Exceptional organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage and track multiple concurrent accounts or projects without losing detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to synthesize complex, multi-stage operational information into clear, concise updates for leadership.
Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot) and/or project management platforms (e.g., Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Notion); ability to build and maintain structured tracking systems.
Ability to work cross-functionally and gather status updates from multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
High attention to detail and discipline around documentation, even when underlying processes are still being defined.
Self-starter mentality with the ability to identify what needs to be tracked and organized, even when the system doesn't yet exist.
Willingness to travel to customer locations for initial site scoping or on-site meetings. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience supporting a customer success or account management function in a hardware, construction technology, or capital equipment environment.
Familiarity with the construction industry, including awareness of project lifecycle stages such as design, pre-construction, site prep, and build phases.
Experience working in early-stage or high-growth companies where processes are being built from the ground up.
Experience with Palantir Foundry, or comparable data and operations platforms, for building internal dashboards, trackers, and cross-team workflows.

Start here. Grown Here.

We have an opportunity for a Consultant Town Planner.
AECOM’s Planning and Stakeholder Engagement business is recruiting Consultant Planners to help deliver our existing portfolio of projects and a pipeline of projects, across a range of sectors, principally delivering large scale infrastructure.

As our Town Planning team is national, and we support hybrid working we are flexible in terms of base location. The role can be based from our offices in Basingstoke, and London Aldgate

Here’s what you’ll do:

You will be joining a market leading, experienced infrastructure planning team and will, be given the following responsibilities.

Planning & Development Management

Assist in the management and successful delivery of major development applications.
Provide planning advice to colleagues and clients, including the application of permitted development rights.
Carry out planning research and analysis and assist with the identification of planning risks.

Technical Reporting & Documentation

Project Coordination & Delivery

Help coordinate multi-disciplinary teams across a variety of project types.
Assist with project management activities to support successful project outcomes.

Business Development & Commercial Support

Contribute to the preparation of successful commercial tenders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Participate in internal and external meetings.

Does this sound like something you can do, and do well? If so, read on…

- We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it’s improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

We have an impressive portfolio of involvement in major infrastructure projects, including delivery of projects through various consenting regimes including Development Consent Orders. We are currently leading on consenting applications for renewables and wider energy/electricity related infrastructure, transport, defence, water and much more.

You will be able to work on a range of prestigious infrastructure projects for our clients in the energy transition, rail and water development sectors, as well as regional and local developments. AECOM is a market leader in UK infrastructure development, with experience of over 80 Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects. Join us now and you could be working on:
numerous solar DCOs with a pipeline of future work;
carbon capture and energy storage projects;
energy transmission schemes including for National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade;
large aviation and rail projects; and
housing and mixed-use development consenting.

PLANNING AT AECOM
- AECOM is a top ten UK Planning consultancy by size, employing around 70 Chartered or Licentiate Planners, practicing in all areas of the discipline. AECOM is also a worldwide leader in environmental and engineering consultancy and working as a planning consultant within AECOM means access to some of the highest profile and prestigious development projects in the UK, working with colleagues operating at the cutting edge of their disciplines as part of the largest UK environmental consultancy.

You will be joining a great team; you will have an interesting and diverse workload and you will be given the opportunity to make the most of your abilities.

What's not to like? Come and join us and we'll grow together.

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Professional Qualifications

Licentiate Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional town planning organisation and working towards full accreditation.

Planning & Technical Expertise

Demonstrable experience of working on major planning applications.
Sound knowledge of UK planning policy and legislation.
Experience of working on Development Consent Order (DCO) and/or Transport and Works Act Order (TWAO) applications.
Understanding of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) legislation.
Experience identifying, evaluating, and managing planning risk.

Commercial & Consultancy Skills

Commercial awareness and the ability to write clearly and concisely.
Consultancy experience, including monitoring and managing project budgets and programmes.

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

Client-focused with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach, demonstrating a high level of commitment to quality.
Experience working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

Project Delivery & Technical Competencies

Ability to work effectively to tight deadlines.
Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

You'll also work closely with other teams across the business, giving feedback on product development and technical issues, and supporting launches of new product features.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

You have a background in Customer Success or Retentions, with real experience retaining customers and handling objections
You're a motivated self-starter who works well independently and is excited by the opportunity to help scale a business during a high-growth phase
You're highly organised with exceptional attention to detail
You are passionate about providing an exceptional customer experience and building lasting relationships
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluency in written and spoken English)
You're tech-savvy and genuinely open to picking up new tools and systems quickly, from our CRM to AI-assisted workflows - we care more about your curiosity and adaptability than which specific tools you've used before

Supporting our clients to achieve great results with Spectre; from proactively ensuring existing clients are getting the most out of the system through strategy calls, quarterly business reviews, and training sessions

Assist with the preparation of masterplans, vision documents and other design-led project outputs.
Contribute to the production of Design and Access Statements and related planning documentation.
Work collaboratively with colleagues to develop design codes and place-based design guidance.
Support Senior and Associate Urban Designers in the delivery of projects, gaining hands-on experience across a variety of project stages and scales.

This role will help deliver sustainable, resilient infrastructure and community developments that create lasting benefits for people, places and the environment. A Collaborator - You work effectively with lots of different people, considering others’ perspectives to shape better outcomes.
A Problem-Solver - You love to give your thoughts based on what you see, being unafraid to challenge conventional thinking.

A competitive salary
Private medical insurance
A range of benefits, including holiday buy and sell, group income protection and life assurance
Permanent employment contract to demonstrate our commitment to your long-term career at Stantec
Professional progression plan, supporting you to gain professional chartership
A supportive and collaborative team environment and Early Careers peer group and wider ERG network (see more on our ERGs here: Stantec Employee Resource Groups )

At Buro Happold, we are redefining what great cities look like—creating places that are sustainable, inclusive, and resilient. We are now seeking an Strategic Planning Consultant to join our Global Urban Strategies team, playing a key leadership role in shaping city-scale solutions across the UK and internationally.

The role will be based from our London office with hybrid working.

We are looking for a person passionate about solving the challenges facing cities who has specialist urban and strategic planning skills to join our London based team.

You will have an opportunity to play a role in shaping and delivering projects combining our data analytics and urban modelling with our core strategic advisory, planning, economics, infrastructure and environment capabilities.

You should have 2+ years post qualification experience. We are looking for a talented urban planner who is a team player and strong project collaborator.

Required Skills

Demonstrate an understanding of urban development challenges and the value of providing integrated urban development and strategic planning solutions.
Excellent problem solver able to interpret and understand the implications of analytical outputs
Awareness and understanding of what it takes to deliver effective and viable client outcomes in a commercial working environment.
Ability to liaise with internal and external clients to promote urban and regional development solutions and deliver high quality input into their projects.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable working with quantitative datasets and building clear data-driven narratives
Demonstrate an ability to prepare high-quality reports of a technical nature.

Specialist technical
and sector expertise
in one or more of the following areas:

Strategic advisory for urban plans, programmes and projects
Preparation of regional and city scale planning frameworks
Development planning and masterplanning of large-scale mixed-use developments
Data analytics and geo-spatial analysis
Understanding of how statutory plan-making systems work: policy hierarchies, evidence requirements and approval processes and the ability to transfer that thinking into unfamiliar national and regional planning contexts.
An awareness of the factors that determine whether plans and projects are deliverable, land ownership and assembly, phasing, infrastructure funding, and governance and delivery arrangements and a willingness to develop this understanding.
Preparation of projects and programmes to support urban development including infrastructure planning and business case for economic, social and green infrastructure programmes and projects.
Demonstrate strong cultural and institutional awareness, recognising how governance structures, land tenure and delivery mechanisms differ between geographies and shape what is deliverable.
Competent in GIS (QGIS or ArcGIS) for spatial analysis and the production of publication-quality mapping;

Desirable Skills

Familiarity with the UK plan-making system, including the NPPF, Local Plans and the emerging spatial development strategy regime for strategic authorities.
Involvement in delivering integrated urban development, strategic spatial planning projects.
Experience in urban resilience, climate change mitigation and adaptation, strategic environmental management and sustainable development strategies
Involvement in delivering regional planning, masterplanning and urban design projects
Working familiarity with CAD (2D and 3D) — in particular georeferencing and converting CAD masterplan, survey and land-parcel drawings for use in GIS
Experience using Adobe Illustrator and InDesign, or similar graphics software
Foreign language skills
Experience of planning practice in more than one country, or of adapting methodologies developed in one regulatory context for use in another
Willingness to travel for client meetings and workshops.

Qualifications

Essential - Degree in a field allied to strategic urban planning such as geography, town planning, social science, geographic information science, environmental science, or architecture.
Desirable - Masters degree in urban planning, spatial planning, urban design, or similar
Desirable – RTPI chartered or with a clear route to Licentiate/Chartered membership; equivalent international body considered.

Role & Responsibilities

Developing tailored consulting technical solutions; delivering an approach that adapts to our clients understanding, experience and needs.
Undertaking pieces of planning and urban development research to feed into projects.
Preparation of technical reports and client presentations.
Engaging with Buro Happold colleagues from other technical disciplines and / or external collaborators to provide integrated reports and solutions for our clients.
Coordinating inputs from other disciplines into integrated deliverables and maintaining the quality, traceability and internal consistency of project outputs, including comment tracking and client response
Contributing towards innovation, technical capability and skills development initiatives and programmes.
Support senior members of the team in preparation of proposals, fee estimates and bid material

new_jobs.description:
Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

The Opportunity

Our award-winning Town Planning team are seeking to recruit a Senior/Principal Planning Consultant to join our Birmingham office to support the leadership and growth of the team. This is a great opportunity to work with Arup planning leadership nationally to develop and grow the Birmingham planning team. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and challenging projects using your leadership, consulting and technical skills.

We would welcome applications from candidates with development management experience to deliver our diverse portfolio of work. What is key to the role is an understanding of the planning context in Birmingham and the West Midlands, with strong work winning skills to maximise our presence in the area.

You will have the opportunity to work across a portfolio of development management projects including commercial, residential, regeneration and infrastructure. You will work closely with the Planning Lead for the Mid-West region which includes the Bristol, Cardiff, Nottingham and Birmingham offices, as well as working closely with various sector leads within the Arup planning team. You will also provide leadership to multidisciplinary planning and design teams.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

Is this role right for you?

The role will have a focus on leading and developing the development management service offer in Birmingham, developing client relationships and identifying project opportunities such as bidding and delivering projects to support raising Arup's profile and promoting our work in the marketplace. You will play a key role in growing our market profile in Birmingham and West Midlands by engaging with existing and potential clients, positioning Arup to ensure there is a strong pipeline and identifying opportunities for new work.

Skills

The role will also involve leading the delivery of projects in terms of client interface, providing strategic direction to the team, ensuring QA and ensuring projects are profitable. This will include interfacing with multi-disciplinary project teams across Arup to ensure client/project opportunities are maximised and integrated delivery of projects. You will have the following skills and attributes:

Education to degree and/or masters in Town Planning and a Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (MRTPI).
Experience of working in Birmingham in a development management with a good understanding of the market.
Experience of working within a commercial environment (bids and projects), including client liaison, programme and time management, quality assurance and financial/budget control.
In-depth knowledge and application of planning legislation and policy, including ongoing reforms.
Proven consultancy skills, working with clients to understand their requirements and business development.
A background in managing teams in the bidding and delivery of projects and sourcing sub-consultants where necessary.

Not ready to apply just yet or have some questions? Contact Rachel Connolly at rachel.connolly@arup.com - Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefitsto help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

new_jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
ICON is looking for a customer service oriented, and operationally driven Senior Customer Success Manager to join our growing Titan Customer Success team. As the first company to commercially scale 3D construction printing, we deploy a complex, multi-stage customer journey from purchasing a printer to planning and executing successful 3D printing construction projects.
We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own relationships with our Titan customers end-to-end - from onboarding through active project support. You'll serve as their primary point of contact for assigned customers and ensure they have what they need to succeed at every stage of a complex, multi-phase journey. You'll also help build the processes and tools that scale the CS function as the team grows.
This role is based at ICON's Austin, TX campus and reports directly to the Director of Customer Success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Ownership
Coordinate closely with the team to ensure every customer interaction, question, and request is handled promptly, professionally, and to the highest standard of customer experience.
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers — owning introductions, ongoing communications, and meeting cadences from onboarding through active project execution.
Own the customer onboarding process end-to-end, ensuring agreements, intake materials, and information packages are completed accurately and on time.
Proactively identify and resolve risks across the customer journey (e.g., contractual obligations, training, material orders, site validations) to keep projects on schedule.

Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate closely within the Customer Success team to organize and coordinate internal cross functional handoffs across Sales, Training, Design, Material Operations, Site Support, and Engineering Services for smooth transitions at each customer journey milestone, and onboard new customers into ICON's internal systems.
Ensure ICON’s centralized customer tracking system, HubSpot, accurately reflects each account’s journey stage and key commitments, giving leadership a reliable view of account health.
Serve as the internal point of contact for tracking customer status, surfacing blockers and gaps, and escalating to the Director of Customer Success with clear context and recommended next steps.
Gather status updates from cross-functional teams to keep customer-facing commitments accurately reflected internally.

Scaling the Team
Leverage AI tools to keep customer data organized at scale, surface patterns, and automate routine tracking. Build internal dashboards, trackers, and reporting templates the broader CS and operations teams adopt.
Build and maintain a library of of customer-facing tools and assets (cost calculators, presentations, forms, timeline visuals, intake questionnaires) that scales the Customer Success journey end-to-end.
Establish internal documentation, SOPs, and templates that standardize how customer information is captured, organized, and communicated across the Customer Success team.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, Architecture or a related field.
8+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, account coordination, project coordination, or operations support.
Exceptional organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage and track multiple concurrent accounts or projects without losing detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to synthesize complex, multi-stage operational information into clear, concise updates for leadership.
Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot) and/or project management platforms (e.g., Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Notion); ability to build and maintain structured tracking systems.
Ability to work cross-functionally and gather status updates from multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
High attention to detail and discipline around documentation, even when underlying processes are still being defined.
Self-starter mentality with the ability to identify what needs to be tracked and organized, even when the system doesn't yet exist.
Willingness to travel to customer locations for initial site scoping or on-site meetings. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience supporting a customer success or account management function in a hardware, construction technology, or capital equipment environment.
Familiarity with the construction industry, including awareness of project lifecycle stages such as design, pre-construction, site prep, and build phases.
Experience working in early-stage or high-growth companies where processes are being built from the ground up.
Experience with Palantir Foundry, or comparable data and operations platforms, for building internal dashboards, trackers, and cross-team workflows.
